verdict.rationale: Docusign's REST API and eSign client SDKs explicitly support embedded signing (envelope signing URLs), and one HN commenter reports a smooth embedded-signing POC and production use with the v2 REST API. But another detailed hands-on account describes a security flaw where users could break out of the embedded signing page into the full account, requiring a downgrade to a legacy, unsupported API version — a concrete contradiction of the 'seamless embed' claim. missing for 10: consistent first-party embedded-signing security guidance, resolution confirmation for the reported vulnerability, and independent verification the issue is fixed in current API versions.
